newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were generally stable in late trading on Monday, after rising in the early session, on limited buying interest, traders said.
They said olein was quoted at 1,445-50 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening but up from 1,435-40 rupiah at Friday's close. Offers were also heard at 1,440 rupiah.
"There was some consumer demand in the morning, but buying interest waned later in the day," one trader said. "Prices also started higher in the morning because of limited sellers."
Traders said prices could hold steady through the week as many players were on holiday.
"Once the selling returns to normal, there will be some pressure on prices," one trader said.

Data from Belawan Port showed that the MV Kang Da will leave the North Sumatran port on Tuesday for South Korea with 3,500 tonnes of palm kernel expeller. The MT Chariot will leave today for Port Klang, Malaysia with 8,025 tonnes of crude palm oil.

The MT Bunga Mawar will leave today for Dumai with 11,000 tonnes of crude palm oil, while the MT Istana-V left on Sunday for Cirebon with 2,000 tonnes of olein. The MT Woloan left for Tanjung Priok on Sunday with 900 tonnes of olein.
